description: List stream packages CREATED or SUBSCRIBED by the signed-in user, including available prices. Use list_stream_packages to browse all packages and get_stream_package_subscription for billing status. Does not create a subscription or charge the user.

limit.description: Maximum number of items in this page.

nextToken.description: nextToken from the previous page; keep the other inputs unchanged.

queryType.description: SUBSCRIBED for packages with an active or trialing subscription; CREATED for packages you created, newest first.

streamPackageCategory.description: Only packages in this topic category. Omit for any category.

name: list_my_stream_packages

id.description: Package ID for get_stream_package or get_stream_package_subscription.

amount.description: Price in the currency’s smallest unit.

title: List my stream packages
